description: Search the employer organization's video transcripts (video_library.transcripts.search): ranked lexical matches (every word must match; no semantic or AI search) over READY, unarchived videos only. Each match returns only assetId, assetTitle, startSeconds/endSeconds of the matching window, and a plain-text snippet of at most 240 characters. Operators and punctuation in query are inert text; an empty or term-free query fails with search_query_invalid. Follow nextCursor with the SAME query and assetId while hasMore=true (a foreign cursor is a 409 conflict). Requires videos:read and rollout access.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of this same query.

query.description: Transcript words to find (every word must match).

name: opentrain_video_library_search_transcripts
